text.p: ABN-AMRO Bank said in a report it had initiated coverage of Brazilian brewery Brahma with a hold rating.
-- said that although cheaper than most Latin American brewers, Brahma is expected to underperform the Brazilian market.

-- "Brahma is attractively valued compared to other Latin American brewers. However, we do not expect its share price to keep pace with Brazilian infrastructure stocks," said analyst Kristi King Etchberger in the report.

-- The analyst also expressed "concerns over Brahma's so far unprofitable foreign expansion, its aggressive tactics to gain soft drinks market share and the increasingly competitive nature of the domestic beer market."
-- also said expects Brahma to experience modest beer volume growth of 4.7 percent in 1997 and 6.5 percent in 1998, due to the continued tight economic policy.
-- Brahma preferred was up 0.12 percent at 821 reais on the Sao Paulo bolsa. Its ADR was up 1/8 at 15-1/4 on the New York Stock Exchange.
